## About

Barcode for WinForms enables you to add barcode images to grid cells, forms or to regular .NET PrintDocument objects.

Key Features:

* Supports 38 standard barcodes.
* Integrated functionality of quick response(QR) code.
* Automatically adds necessary control symbols and checksums to the value being encoded.
* Royalty-free dll that can be distributed with applications for easy deployment.

Learn more at [developer.mescius.com/componentone/barcode-control-net](https://developer.mescius.com/componentone/barcode-control-net).
